newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein extends losses.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein extends losses.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices fell further in late trading on Tuesday as buyers stayed sidelined amid ample supply, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,415-20 rupiah at the opening. There were no known trades in crude palm oil but offers were heard at 1,220 rupiah.
"There are some players with plenty of cheap oil who are forcing down prices," one trader said. "The others have no choice but to follow their leads."
Traders said there was a possibility that prices could touch 1,400 rupiah by end of the week.
They said a general weakening of Malaysian prices was also dampening local sentiment.
The traders said they were also waiting for the government to announce the December export taxes on crude palm oil and three products.
A Finance Ministry official said the taxes could be announced by this week.
Traders said they expected the tax on crude palm oil to rise to $43-$44/tonne from $28 in November. The tax on olein was estimated at $41/tonne against $18.75 last month.
